title: light-daltonized Theme is Unreadable
body:

- Operating System: macOS 11,17

## Bug Description

As title says. I've chosen the dark text theme which, according to `/config` is called "light-daltonized"...

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e4d550e4-38c0-4da7-8d9d-85c9863c522a)

...and highlighted text is using a colour choice that only Stevie Wonder could decipher:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0f587a27-9516-4bc5-b0bb-d0de879671c6)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2468500c-f911-40ac-b24c-1ea566a2bdc5)

..and this is supposed to be a colour blind friendly theme!
